packages.title: The "North Goa Pulse" (Action & Nightlife)
packages.best_for: A quick break where the focus is on a specific region of Goa.

itinerary.title: Arrival & Sunset
activities: Early morning departure from Pune via Belagavi and Chorla Ghat.
Arrive in North Goa by late afternoon.
Evening visit to Aguada Fort for sunset, followed by dinner at a beach shack in Candolim.

itinerary.title: Beach Hopping & Forts
activities: Spend the morning at Baga and Calangute.
Afternoon visit to Chapora Fort (the "Dil Chahta Hai" fort) and a scenic sunset at Vagator Beach.

itinerary.title: Water Sports & Panjim
activities: Morning water sports (parasailing, jet ski) at Anjuna or Candolim.
Post-lunch, visit the colorful Fontainhas (Latin Quarter) in Panjim and enjoy a Mandovi River cruise.

itinerary.title: Departure
activities: Breakfast and early departure back to Pune.

packages.title: The "Best of Both Worlds" (North & South Mix)
packages.best_for: A comprehensive experience that covers both nature and culture.

itinerary.title: Arrival
activities: Drive from Pune to North Goa.
Evening walk at Sinquerim Beach.

itinerary.title: North Goa Exploration
activities: Visit the famous northern belt: Anjuna, Vagator, and Chapora Fort.
Experience a popular beach club or night market in the evening.

itinerary.title: Heritage & Panjim
activities: Visit Old Goa’s historic churches, followed by the Mangueshi Temple.
Spend the evening walking through the vibrant streets of Panjim.

itinerary.title: South Goa Escape
activities: Head to South Goa for the day.
Relax at Varca or Majorda Beach, known for their white sands and peaceful atmosphere.

itinerary.title: Departure
activities: Return drive to Pune.

packages.title: The "North Goa Power Trip"
packages.best_for: Those who want a quick escape and don't mind the long drive.

itinerary.title: The Long Drive
activities: Early morning departure (5:00 AM) from Mumbai via NH48 (Pune-Kolhapur-Belgaum).
Arrive in North Goa by evening.
Check-in and relax at a beach shack in Calangute.

itinerary.title: Forts & Sunsets
activities: Visit Aguada Fort and the lighthouse in the morning.
Spend the afternoon at Vagator Beach and climb up to Chapora Fort for the iconic sunset view.

itinerary.title: Panjim & Vibes
activities: Head to Panjim for a walk through the colorful Fontainhas Latin Quarter.
In the evening, explore the cafes of Anjuna or enjoy a sunset cruise on the Mandovi River.

itinerary.title: Return Leg
activities: Breakfast and early departure.
Stop at Kolhapur for a quick lunch break before heading back to Mumbai.

packages.title: The "Grand Goan Circuit" (North & South Mix)
packages.best_for: A more relaxed pace or for travelers who want to see "Hidden Goa."

itinerary.title: Arrival in the North
activities: Drive from Mumbai to North Goa.
Evening at leisure at Candolim Beach.

itinerary.title: The Northern Hub
activities: Explore the "famous" Goa—Baga, Calangute, and Anjuna.
Evening visit to a local night market (if seasonal) or a popular beach club.

itinerary.title: Central Heritage & Spice
activities: Visit Old Goa in the morning.
Afternoon lunch at a Spice Plantation in Ponda, followed by a visit to the Mangueshi Temple.

itinerary.title: South Goa Serenity
activities: Move toward the South.
Spend the day at Agonda Beach or Colva.
This provides a peaceful contrast to the North Goa bustle.

itinerary.title: Homebound
activities: Early morning start for the return journey to Mumbai.
